fieldNotes.maxGuests: APTDATA.beds is shown under "מס׳ אורחים מקסימלי" (Max. guests) - it is NOT a bedroom count
fieldNotes.outdoor: APTDATA.balcony is the one-decimal sum of the plan's BALCONY/GARDEN labels; parts[] keep the exact plan values and which facade each is on (x<300 pt street, x>1000 pt rear)
fieldNotes.price: live price from Firebase wins; APTDATA.p is the offline floor (identical to live at fetch time)
fieldNotes.status: live status wins; offline floor = sold-gate-js SOLD list (everything else avail). Values: avail | reserved | sold
fieldNotes.type: APTDATA.n minus the code. English in both languages (the page translator has no entries for type names)
fieldNotes.position: sheet coordinates of the architect PDF: street (KOUNTOURIOTOU STREET) on the left edge of every sheet; top/bottom are the side neighbours - no compass on the sheets (title block gives only 37°56'N · 23°38'E)

_meta.copiedBy: tools/copy-media.mjs 2026-11-05T21:42:28.010Z from tools/inputs/units.src.json (= understand phase scratchpad h3d/data/units.json; its sources are listed above)

added.levelId: contract level id (basement, ground, first, second, third, roof); `level` keeps the data id (garden, ground, 1, 2, 3)
added.glbUnitNode: unit floor patch node in public/models/harbour.glb (under interior_<levelId>)
added.fflM: finished floor level, frame z metres
added.labelAnchorFrame: deepest point of the unit footprint [x, y], frame metres (use z = fflM) - a safe spot for a 3D tag (tools/inputs/unit-anchors.json; C1-C4 reuse B1-B4)
added.facing: which facade the unit opens to; bearingDeg (a list for Y3, which opens both ways) from site.json headingDeg
